items.title: A.J. Brown: Remains absent from practice
items.text:
Brown (hamstring) wasn't spotted on the field for Tuesday's unofficial practice, Evan Lazar of the Patriots' official site reports.

The Packers reinstated Parsons (knee) from the PUP list on Tuesday.

items.title: Micah Parsons: Questionable, but should debut Wednesday
items.text:
Parsons (knee) is officially listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against the Rams, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

items.title: J.K. Dobbins: Handed team-imposed one-game ban
items.text:
Broncos head coach Sean Payton announced Tuesday that Dobbins has been suspended one game for conduct detrimental to the team, Chris Tomasson of The Denver Gazette reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
